name: Bitcoin Frogs (比特蛙)
description: 比特蛙 Bitcoin Frogs ($Frogs) fair mint on BNB Smart Chain, only for Binance Agentic Wallets holding a .ai Agent ID. Sale opens 2026-10-31 21:30 CST. Shares 1-2,000 free (one per Agent ID, claimFree()), 2,001-7,000 cost 1 USDT, 7,001-10,000 cost 2 USDT; 100% parked for the pool. At share 10,000 the contract opens the PancakeSwap Frogs/USDT pool (11,000 USDT + 550B Frogs) and burns the LP. No pause function: nobody can pause or stop minting. Independent project, not affiliated with Binance. No promised returns.

wallet.required: Binance Agentic Wallet (baw CLI) holding a .ai Agent ID
wallet.signing: The agent previews every transaction and its owner approves it in their own wallet; the API never holds keys.

skills.name: Mint Bitcoin Frogs ($Frogs) shares
skills.description: Check eligibility (.ai Agent ID), from 2026-10-31 21:30 CST claim the one free share per Agent ID while shares 1-2,000 last, then quote the price and mint 1-10 paid $Frogs shares per transaction (1 USDT to #7,000, 2 USDT to #10,000) with USDT or BNB from a Binance Agentic Wallet on BNB Chain.
examples: Claim my free Bitcoin Frogs share with my agent wallet
Mint 5 Bitcoin Frogs shares with my agent wallet
How many Bitcoin Frogs shares are left before the pool opens?

skills.name: Read Bitcoin Frogs mint state
skills.description: Read-only: sale start (21:30 CST), shares minted, free shares claimed, current price, USDT parked for the pool, BNB quotes, and whether a wallet holds a .ai Agent ID. No wallet needed.
